verifiable-quality-gates.why: the harness is a check proven to detect: injecting a real content difference into the hook and reverting esk-genesis to no-clobber makes the convergence check fail, naming .githooks/pre-push
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added a prev-release-install -> upgrade -> converge test plus a real-pre-push-hook-runs test, and proved discrimination by injecting a content diff and reverting the refresh, then restored both
quotes: test must FAIL when the check is replaced by a no-op

architectural-decision-records.why: the testing-strategy decision (install prev release, upgrade, converge; what it discriminates and what it does not) is recorded in one ADR with the change
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR-0070 documenting the harness, the two checks, and the honest discrimination limit and follow-ups
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: an upgrade-propagation bug across a real release transition can only be caught faithfully by an integration test that installs the prior release and upgrades, so the test type matches the risk
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: added an integration harness that materializes v1.2.1 via git worktree, upgrades to HEAD, asserts convergence, and runs the real pre-push hook
quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug, and match the test type to the risk.

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: the existing-consumer upgrade path and the hook-runs path were enumerated and committed as executable tests
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: two node:test cases: prev-release install then upgrade then converge, and the installed hook runs the manifest gates and passes
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment.

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR states the honest discrimination limit: the convergence check only discriminates when a travelling file's content changed between the pair, proven by injection, and PR1's test is the content-agnostic guard
skeptical-audit.what: recorded the limit and the injection proof in ADR-0070 Consequences, and did not overclaim the convergence check as the bug's discrimination on this pair
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

judge-arch.why: a fresh-context review was run on the change before opening the PR and recorded in the arch-review log
judge-arch.what: ran judge-arch in a fresh subagent over the harness and the wiring, resolved findings, and recorded the review
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.

arch-encode.why: no new greppable rule to encode; this adds an integration test, enforced by the test itself, not by a rules-file entry

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no PII, retention, migration, backup or audit logic; this is a test harness

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system, service, database or integration architecture changed; this is test infrastructure

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: no input, auth, session, crypto, upload or dependency surface changed; the test spawns node and git on temp dirs it created

pattern-selector.why: no new feature, class, module or data flow; this is a test that drives the existing installer

release-deployment-safety.why: no deploy, migration, feature-flag or rollback mechanism changed; this test exercises the upgrade path but does not change the mechanism

sre-operational-readiness.why: no SLI/SLO, alert, runbook or production-operability surface changed

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: no user-facing or UI surface; this is developer-facing test infrastructure

universal-browser-device-support.why: no frontend or browser-facing code; this is developer-facing test infrastructure

usability-ux-universal-design.why: no user-facing flow, screen, form or copy; this is developer-facing test infrastructure
